_about: U7 agent-id label mode: the id label forms, the bracket full-id suffix, the label template that replaced the plain dual-render (frame f1.7 of the sidechain-capture-release gauntlet, 2026-09-03). M1-Mn: fresh-context generator (mode 1, zero tools, source excerpts only). Root: an ISOLATED COPY of hooks/ + tests/one-offs/ under the session scratchpad.

mutations.note: reason: label width silently narrowed -- ids render as `explore/a7c41e` instead of the 8-char `explore/a7c41e0b`, so any test asserting the exact short form must fail.
reason: None/empty guard dropped -- short_agent_id(None) returns the string 'None', so an entry with no agent id renders `explore/None` instead of plain `explore`.

mutations.original: with_id = mode in AGENT_LABEL_ID_MODES or norm == UNTYPED_AGENT_CLASSIFIER
mutations.note: reason: untyped clause dropped -- the untyped bucket loses its short id under always/auto, collapsing every unnamed agent back into one indistinguishable `untyped` label.

reason: auto-id no longer counts as an auto mode -- inside the agent's own file (agents-explore) the type stops being dropped, so labels read `explore/a7c41e0b` where they should read bare `a7c41e0b`.

mutations.note: reason: the bracket suffix carries the short id instead of the full one -- `[id a7c41e0b]` instead of `[id a7c41e0b9d2f53e18]`, destroying the one place the whole id is recorded.
reason: with_id ignored -- the baked always-mode string picks up the id, so always/auto channels start rendering `Bash|explore/a7c41e0b` and no longer match the pre-feature output.
reason: the template is baked with the already-rendered tool_display rather than the sentinel -- the formatter's replace() finds nothing, so id-mode labels never reach precomputed tool lines.

reason: the uncategorized `?` prefix is lost from tool_display_base -- unknown tools keep `?` in always mode but silently lose it in the id modes, breaking grep-by-`{?Tool` in exactly the channels that relabel.
reason: the labelled summary template loses the trailing marker -- id-mode template entries drop the marker that the always-mode summary still carries, so the two renderings diverge.
reason: the legacy template is only filled when a summary exists -- summary-less tools (Bash, Read, Grep) fall back to the always string and never show the id label.
reason: the chat formatter drops the bracket suffix -- agent-start/agent-stop lines in chat channels lose ` [id a7c41e0b9d2f53e18]` while the default formatter still emits it.
reason: config merge rejects the new modes -- `agent_label: "id"` / `"auto-id"` in user config is silently discarded and the channel keeps the default always mode.
